## Checklist

- [ ] `npm test` passes
- [ ] Edited `shared/` (not the copies) and ran `npm run sync`, if the codec/helpers changed
- [ ] ASCII punctuation only in code, comments, and docs
- [ ] No new dependencies
- [ ] No new or widened browser permission (or: README table + `PRIVACY.md` updated)
- [ ] No backend, analytics, or remote code added
- [ ] Did not bump the version (maintainer does this at release)
- [ ] Updated docs / `CHANGELOG.md` if user-facing
